newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 486.75/487.75/dlr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar ends softer at 486.75/487.75/dlr.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed softer at 486.75/487.75 per dollar in quiet trade as the Central Bank largely kept back from the market, traders said.
"The only supply of dollars today was from the Central Bank, and then only droplets," said one trader.
The bolivar closed Friday at 485.75/486.75 per dollar.

Venezuela's foreign exchange market is unusual in that the Central Bank is its largest single supplier of dollars, which blurs the difference between the Central Bank supplying liquidity and intervening.

Traders said dollar demand was likely to rise as foreign investors began to take profits on the Caracas bolsa that rocketed ahead Monday to its eighth straight record high. ((-- Silene Ramirez, Caracas newsroom, 582 505 2600))
